nama_produk_baru: A Method of Identifying One of More Targets
penyelidik_bersama: Zulkalnain bin Mohd Yussof, Soo Yew Guan, Tan Kien Leong, Mohd Hasbullah bin Putra, Alvin Siah Kuok Lim, Chua Kah Keong
abstrak: The present invention relates to a method (100) of retrieving an image frame for identifying a target, in which the method (100) comprising the steps of capturing and recording a video image using a visual recording device, sniffing a medium access control address transmitted by a device of the target via a wireless network detector as a sniffing device, filtering the sniffed medium access control address, tagging an image frame from the recorded video image with the filtered medium access control address, and retrieving the image frame by selecting the image frame tagged with the filtered medium access control address. In addition, the medium access control address is filtered via Received Signal Strength Indication thresholding. Further, the image frame tagged with the filtered medium access control address is prioritized for processing.

nama_produk: Double rotor slotted with dual-rotation brushless direct current, dc motor for automation application
nama_produk_baru: A Dual Rotation Brushless Motor & Uses Thereof
nama_penyelidik: Raja Nor Firdaus Kashfi bin Raja Othman
penyelidik_bersama: Dr. Fairul Azhar bin Abdul Shukor
abstrak: The present invention relates to a dual rotation brushless motor comprising an inner rotor, an outer rotor, a dual shaft having a first shaft and a second shaft, and a stator having an inner stator and an outer stator. The rotors have a plurality of permanent magnets slotted in their core. The first shaft and second shaft are connected to respective inner rotor and outer rotor, configured to rotate around an axis. In addition, the stator comprises a non-magnetic material, a plurality of coil windings that complements with a plurality of stator teeth, located between the rotors. The plurality of permanent magnets is arranged in an end-toend position at a circumferential direction of the rotors. Moreover, the rotors are configured to rotate in an opposite direction at synchronous speed simultaneously. Further, the plurality of permanent magnets is arranged to be parallel to each other, resulting in a magnetic flux, which in turns, produces a parallel magnetization.

abstrak: The present invention relates to a method of fabricating a fin field-effect transistor, characterized by the steps of providing a silicon carbide substrate, forming a source region and a drain region on the silicon carbide substrate, defining a fin region connecting the source region and the drain region, depositing a mask layer on the source region, the drain region and the fin region to expose remaining region on the silicon carbide substrate, etching the exposed region to a certain depth to form a framework having a fin-like structure disposed between the source region and the drain region, removing the mask layer, depositing metal films on the source region and the drain region to form ohmic contacts, annealing the framework in forming gas to form metal silicide at the ohmic contacts, depositing gate dielectric on the framework, etching the gate dielectric on the ohmic contacts to open the source contact and the drain contact  and depositing a gate contact over the gate dielectric.

abstrak: The present invention relates to a rotary cutting tool for trim and rout operations of materials, particularly carbon fibre reinforced plastics. The rotary cutting tool comprises a cylindrical shaft body including a cutting portion and a shank portion extending from the cutting portion, in which the cylindrical shaft body is rotatable in a direction of rotation about a longitudinal axis. A plurality of left-hand helical flutes intersects with a plurality of right-hand helical flutes around a circumference of the cutting portion. A plurality of cutting teeth are disposed at intersections formed by the left-hand helical flutes and the right-hand helical flutes. The cutting teeth protrude and curve towards the direction of rotation with a tapering end. Further, the number of the left-hand helical flutes is 12, the number of the right-hand helical flutes is 8, and the helix angle for the left-hand helical flutes and the right-hand helical flutes is 24 degrees.

abstrak: A wafer dicing method is provided comprising the following steps: placing a wafer ring and wafer on a mounter chuck table, then securing them with vacuum. A mounting tape is applied to the wafer’s backside using a roller. The assembly is then flipped. UV mounting tape is applied to the wafer’s topside, extending to the wafer ring, creating a mounted wafer. The mounted wafer is removed from the chuck table and placed into a dicing machine. It is diced, cleaned with water, and unloaded. UV curing is then performed on the topside, followed by cleaning to remove the UV tape. Finally, the diced wafer is unloaded. This feature provides a cushioning effect and additional gripping during wafer dicing. A decrease in the vibration during dicing resulting in chipping reduction on the topside surface and backside surface of the wafer.

abstrak: A hybrid filament composite with polylactic acid (PLA), sugar palm fiber (SPF) and waste tyre rubber (WTR) has been developed to present on sustainable materials and environmental concerns. The SPF is renewable, biodegradable, and eco-friendly while WTR is also useful for improving composite properties. This research focuses on creating PLA as a matrix material for these green composites filaments reinforced with SPF and WTR for 3D printing. WTR and SPF were treated with 6% NaOH and 3% silane to improve interfacial adhesion with 97.5%PLA:2.5%SPF/WTR. Three different fiber loadings were evaluated 75%SPF:25%WTR, 50%SPF:50%WTR, and 25%SPF:75%WTR. The fabricated filaments from a twin-screw extruder were used to 3D print tensile ASTM D638, and flexural ASTM D790 test specimens. The 75%SPF:25%WTR composite exhibited the best mechanical properties, with a tensile strength of 37.89 MPa and a flexural strength of 54.52 MPa. Additionally, scanning electron microscopy (SEM) analysis confirmed that the 75%SPF:25%WTR of this combination resulted in superior tensile strength. Enhanced performance is attributed to the improved interfacial adhesion between the treated fibers and the PLA matrix, as well as the uniform dispersion of the fibers within the composite. According to these findings, SPF and WTR hybrid composites are highly sustainable and high-performance alternatives to petroleum-based plastics.

It comprises a resonator array (12) of truncated C-shaped coupled-line resonators fabricated on a substrate (14), each tuned to produce a unique frequency notch representing a binary bit. A microstrip transmission line (18) connects both ends of the substrate between two RF ports (16), forming a continuous 50-ohm signal path for data interrogation. This configuration enables reliable, spectral encoding of data without the need for chips or active components. The device is compatible with standard RF test equipment and supports compact, scalable integration.
